model_annotation: The plot displays two separate line graphs comparing the training rewards of two algorithms, "Llama-On-Policy" and "Llama-LUFFY", across different training set difficulties. The top graph, labeled "Easy Training Set", shows training rewards on the y-axis ranging from 0.0 to 0.4, plotted against steps on the x-axis from 0 to approximately 500. The blue line, representing "Llama-On-Policy-Easy", starts near 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.35 by 500 steps. The red line, representing "Llama-LUFFY-Easy", also begins near 0.0, rises to approximately 0.38 by 500 steps, and remains consistently above the blue line throughout. The bottom graph, labeled "Hard Training Set", shows training rewards on the y-axis ranging from 0.0 to 0.2, plotted against steps on the x-axis from 0 to 500. The blue line, representing "Llama-On-Policy-Hard", starts near 0.0 and quickly declines to near 0.0 by approximately 100 steps, remaining near 0.0 for the remainder of the steps. The red line, representing "Llama-LUFFY-Hard", starts near 0.0, rises to approximately 0.15 by 200 steps, and continues to rise to approximately 0.2 by 500 steps, remaining consistently above the blue line throughout. Both graphs use a linear scale for both axes.
